text:
deploy-bot: rollout complete for inference-gateway v2.18.4 -> prod. canary 10% -> 100%. starting postdeploy synthetic checks (kv-warmup + prefix + /embed smoke).
maria: kicking off smoke run now — running kv warmup and embed synthetic across eu/us.
lee: seeing a small p95 blip on eu1 for /embed, ~420ms for a minute, now back to ~130ms. tagging logs.
niko: no config changes to batching from this deploy, we did swap quant variant to q4_8 for eu embed model — that could affect latencies.
sam: deploy-bot synthetic shows intermittent 503s on /embed in us-west-2 between 3795551245-3795551255, about 6 failures, error body: "upstream timeout".
ops-bot: alert: synth_probe_failure service=inference-gateway route=/embed region=us-west-2 count=6
maria: can someone paste the probe curl? I want to replay locally.
lee: here — curl to the smoke endpoint:
```
curl -sS -X POST https://smoke.internal.redwood/api/v1/smoke/embed -d '{"prompt":"test"}' -H "x-region: us-west-2"
```
niko: tailing pod logs now, seeing repeated `ReadTimeoutError` from embed-worker at ~3795551246. also KV warmup hits are higher than baseline.
sam: trying a quick replay from a warm node — I can reproduce a 500s spike once, then stable. looks like short connection saturation window.
maria: two options: pin traffic back to v2.18.3 (full rollback) or route embed traffic to fallback model variant (q4_0) in affected regions. prefer least-disruptive first.
lee: +1 to variant pin for eu/us-west, keep binary version. low blast radius and preserves other fixes in v2.18.4.
niko: I can flip model-variant routing for those regions in the routing-config; 2 min change and reversible.
deploy-bot: rolling back model_variant routing for inference-gateway.embed in regions [us-west-2, eu1] to q4_0 (from q4_8). traffic shift: 100% to q4_0 for embed in those regions. started at 3795551262.
maria: thanks. I'll pause canary rollout notes and add a blurb to release notes that we pinned embed variant in two regions while we investigate.
lee: monitoring p95 now — initial data looks back to baseline within 30s.
ops-bot: synth_probe_recovery service=inference-gateway route=/embed region=us-west-2 status=ok at 3795551288
sam: confirmed no more 503s in the last 2 min for the synthetic run.
maria: decision: no full rollback. keep v2.18.4, model-variant pin until root cause found. will open an investigation ticket (INC-2026-1123) and add to next retro.
niko: collecting heap/connection metrics from embed workers; will post logs in the ticket.
maria: noted. tagging @oncall to watch for regressions during change window. :eyes:
lee: thumbs for plan. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: action log: variant-pin applied, canary paused, incident ticket INC-2026-1123 created, change window flag set to sticky. finish time 3795551300.
maria: monitoring continues, will update thread with final status and then update the release notes entry.
